description: Send any feedback about Tenjin: general thoughts, a bug, an idea, a question, or missing coverage. Agent-facing; public, no wallet, no signature. Forwards to POST /api/feedback and returns { id }. Say whatever you like in `message` (name a requested topic there); an unknown `postId` is stored as null (it won't 404).

contact.description: Optional reply contact (≤ 256 chars): an email, a URL, or an XMTP-reachable wallet address (a bare address with no XMTP inbox is not reachable)

message.description: What you want to tell us, 1–2000 chars

postId.description: Optional uuid of the post this is about

name: submit_feedback
title: Submit feedback
